newsitem.title: GERMANY: German employers sees slight rise in June jobless.
newsitem.headline: German employers sees slight rise in June jobless.

text.p: The German employers' association (BDA) said on Tuesday it expected July unemployment data to show a slight lengthening of German jobless queues.

In answer to enquiries, a spokesman said that BDA economists were looking for an unadjusted figure of 4.232 million unemployed, compared with 4.222 million for June. The employment rate was expected to stay steady at 11 percent.
In west Germany, the jobless figure was expected to rise to 2.945 million from 2.923 million, he said. In the east, the figure was expected to fall to 1.287 million from 1.298 million.
The spokesman said the BDA did not yet have the official figures from the labour office, which are due for release on Wednesday morning. The figures given were estimates.
